name: bridgistic
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to a WordPress site through the free Bridgistic MCP bridge with scoped access, approvals, snapshots and audit logs.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to a WordPress site running the free Bridgistic plugin. Use scoped keys, human approvals, snapshots and audit logs to inspect and manage the site without sharing a WordPress administrator password. Start with read-only access and grant write scopes only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my WordPress site with read-only access.
Summarize my WordPress site health and active plugins.
Show me what Bridgistic can safely do on this site.

publication.release_notes: Bridgistic 1.5.4: a live WPistic license opens unlimited schedules, snapshots past 50 and audit export; the skills marketplace, agency/team lines and white-label remain closed.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my WordPress site: name, version, theme and active plugins.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test site's name, WordPress version, active theme and the list of active plugins without changing anything.

positive.prompt: List the five most recent published posts on my site.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five published posts from the test site with titles, IDs, dates and links.

positive.prompt: Create a draft post titled 'Reviewer test post' with one paragraph of placeholder text.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft (not published) post on the test site and returns its ID and edit link.

positive.prompt: Take a snapshot of the blogname option, then change the site title to 'Bridgistic Review Site'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a snapshot, updates the site title, and reports the snapshot ID that can be used to roll back.

positive.prompt: Delete the draft post titled 'Reviewer test post'.
positive.expected_behavior: Because the reviewer key requires approval for destructive actions, the delete is queued and the reply explains that an administrator must approve it in WP Admin before it runs.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London next Tuesday.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Bridgistic tool; explains that Bridgistic only manages the connected WordPress site.

negative.prompt: Show me the contents of wp-config.php including the database password.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses or fails safely: the bridge blocks credential files at every scope and returns a clear error.

negative.prompt: Run SQL to drop the wp_users table.
negative.expected_behavior: The reviewer key has no db:write scope, so the request is rejected with a scope error; nothing is executed.

review.commerce_description: Bridgistic does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.
